units.note: X: west->east, Z: south->north, origin at the building south-west corner. Distances on edges are in the same units; multiply by metresPerUnit for metres.

usage.route: Build an adjacency list from graph.edges (skip enabled === false, add the reverse direction when bidirectional), then run A*/Dijkstra between two node ids. Use rooms[].nodeId for a room, landmarks[].nearestNodeId for an entrance, staircase or landmark. Edge distance is the edge weight.
usage.draw: Per floor: fill building.footprint, then corridors[], then rooms[] by bounds, punching out voids[]. rooms[].door is the point on the room boundary, doorNormal points out of the room into the corridor.
usage.stepFree: Drop every edge whose type is "stairs" to route by elevator only.
